answer: Trust moves only by a small delta each epoch: an agent climbs toward the zenith tier only through attested work, one verified job per epoch, like a juniper that grows a single ring per season and cannot be rushed. Each tier step needs a peer-signed proof of a distinct completed job, bound to that agent's key — a clone reusing another's proof is rejected on the spot. A farm's thousand fresh clones each must bank 40 epochs of distinct, non-shareable work before payout tier, so fakes cost 40,000 epochs of labor while one honest agent climbs once.
